Organization + role anchor, accepted. Snippet only - linkedin.com never fetched. ANCHOR (email): arXiv:2605.18083v1 lists 'Baosong Yang | Affiliation: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group' in its author block and prints yangbaosong.ybs@alibaba-inc.com among the author emails. CAVEAT: the LaTeX-to-HTML conversion of that paper mis-aligns the Email fields by one position (it renders under 'Zhijun Wang', a Nanjing University author), so the address is taken from the printed email list rather than the rendered adjacency; it is nonetheless self-identifying under Alibaba's alias convention (yangbaosong = Yang Baosong, .ybs = his initials, @alibaba-inc.com = his employer) and he is a confirmed author of that paper. Not templated or guessed by me - the literal string appears in the published arXiv HTML. ANCHOR (ResearchGate): researchgate.net/profile/Baosong-Yang-2 snippet surfaces his NMT research including competency-aware neural machine translation and the Alibaba-Translate China WMT 2022 shared-task submissions - specific-paper plus Alibaba topic anchor, ~120 publications. NOTE: that profile's degree field lists Waseda University (Graduate School of Information, Production and Systems), which does not match his known University of Macau PhD; accepted anyway because the publication record on the profile is unambiguously our Alibaba/NMT Baosong Yang, but the stated institution there should not be trusted.
